gates.meaning: Module/model applicability and state required; module status does not prove successful network reachability.
Read whole documented group/block atomically enough for its semantics.
Commercialp7 explicitly excludes SUN2000V100R001/V200R001/V200R002 and SUN2000HAV100R001. Positive model applicability remains missing.
Preserve maintenance/R&D instrumentation intent; undefined internal fields are not stable plant-state abstractions.
Dongle-related observations are separate component state; no gateway/session qualification inferred.
Bind plant/storage/load values to EMMA configuration and associated components; a readable aggregate is not active hardware proof.
LB-C10p79–80 public registers describe devices associated through EMMA; do not transplant the previous section’s fixed unit0 rule to every associated device.
Interpret counts with the documented search-state result and component identity.
External EMMA sensor channel; verify associated meter and physical topology separately.
Built-in EMMA sensor channel; verify sensor context and physical topology separately.
LB-C10p59 section3.3 targets EMMA at logical ID0; these are not inverter identity/telemetry rows.
Preserve0xFFFF as no displayed state; do not map it to a running mode.
Preserve period/cumulative meaning and source collection time; do not infer reset or local-midnight behavior beyond documentation.
Use exact source alarm/cause/bit table; C81 uses separate50000–50016 bank, other profiles cannot inherit it.
Exact model token/ID and applicable endpoint scope select the documentary contract. A stated minimum is an inclusive floor; edition is a citation key. undocumented branch relation lowers confidence.
Apply source wiring predicates; HB3-wire line versus4-wire phase differs from L/N and split-phase re-labeling in HD/common maps.
Only documented exact-profile states/bits may receive labels; unknown/reserved values stay UNKNOWN.
License eligibility/status/expiration differs from installed hardware, configured feature and live operation.
Version/name/component records identify documentary objects; absence or readable placeholder does not establish support.
Identify DC-MBUS endpoint/component; no optimizer or network presence inferred from status register alone.
Require exact-source online/type/model association and valid phase topology;37113 sign alone does not establish a meter.
Use exact model MPPT count and source channel identities, not register readability.
Prediction is not measured output and does not establish a supported/active MPPT count.
Management/WLAN/NTP/FE context is interface-specific; no route/session reachability inferred.
Use documented model/grid-code support, device totals/online state and source metadata/file association; no active optimizer inferred.
Require associated storage unit and actual pack slot; pack enum cannot be borrowed from unit enum.
preserve compound packet and exact request enum.
PID-reported single-stage context applies where explicitly stated.
Use exact model/string-count and documented channel map; C81 sparse32262/32314 layout is independent from32016/32344 layouts.
Correct logical endpoint, successful well-formed FC03 response, current data and source validity are independently required; timeout is not absence.
Keep source local/epoch convention and collection/start/stop meaning; timezone conversion not inferred.
Source star-marked rows depend on model or grid code; exact support must be established, not assumed for all supported-model rows.
Honor source battery-vendor support columns and complete footnotes; no vendor support inherited from another profile.
One attached unit maps to unit1; where documented, a second LUNA unit maps to unit2. Active running/identity is a separate runtime gate.
Require exact associated tracker/controller and its own model/enum dictionary; dual-axis count ceiling is8 where documented.
